chapterTitle: Chapter 26 Biomolecules: Amino Acids, Peptides, and Proteins
title: Problem 26-15

pages.text: PROBLEM 26-15 Give the amino acid sequence of hexapeptides that produce the following sets of fragments upon partial acid hydrolysis: (a) Arg, Gly, Ile, Leu, Pro, Val gives Pro-Leu-Gly, Arg-Pro, Gly-Ile-Val (b) N, L, M, W, V2 gives V-L, V-M-W, W-N-V
